theorem.name: Conditional Coherence Rupture Correspondence
theorem.statement: Let (u,p,f) be the forced Navier-Stokes construction supplied by the OpenAI manuscript on ℝ³ × [0,T), and let an NSFG translation map produce (ψ,Φ,Δ,ℋ). The OpenAI construction establishes the classical blow-up behavior. If the translation layer additionally satisfies the required coercive and reverse estimates specified below, then the corresponding NSFG coherence-rupture conditions follow, and the proposed Convergence Boundary interpretation becomes mathematically supported.

conditions.source_blowup: limsup_{t→T} ||u(t)||_{L∞(ℝ³)} = ∞ and/or the corresponding classical derivative blow-up asserted by the construction.
conditions.candidate_rupture: Δ(t) crosses Δcrit and/or ℋ(t) diverges.
conditions.candidate_boundary: The observer-relative accessible continuation functional collapses according to the independently defined NSFG boundary criterion.

inequalities.rationale: An upper bound does not provide the reverse implication Δ → ∞ ⇒ ||∇u|| → ∞.

inequalities.statement: Δ ≤ C3(appropriate classical norms plus explicitly controlled A-terms) may be retained only as a forward estimate.
inequalities.rationale: The current proof incorrectly uses this upper bound to infer Δ → ∞ from classical gradient blow-up.

inequalities.rationale: The current proof incorrectly infers ℋ → ∞ from an upper bound whose right-hand side diverges.

inequalities.reason: I5 invokes the Coherence Rupture Equivalence Theorem to prove the Coherence Rupture Equivalence Theorem and is therefore circular.
